onset_head.input: Per-pitch recurrent state (the same state used by the pitch heads)
onset_head.calibration: None; the sigmoid of the onset logit is used directly

onset_loss.target: Triangular target spanning 2 frames on each side of each annotated note onset

calibration.selection: Equal average F1 across the calibration datasets, averaged equally between clean and mixed audio.
calibration.application: MIDI21-47/48-71/72-91 use band biases; MIDI92-108 uses global bias
calibration.folding: Float32 (band - global) added to per-pitch bias.

onset_rule.scope: Fixed constants for the SFZ Note Player onset rule; evaluated with this model

runtime: Fixed float32 weights; no runtime training or adaptation.
training_exclusion: Development and held-out test data were excluded from training and calibration.

training_additions.scope: Configured probability of adding synthetic notes to eligible audio segments that are not replaced by GeneralUser GS renders; these segments also contain base-dataset audio
Drum replacement frequencies measured in 2000 sampled audio segments; not totals over all training steps

Configured probability of replacing a whole audio segment with notes rendered from this SoundFont (General MIDI melodic instruments; single notes, octaves, fifths, two-note chords and repeated notes); these segments contain no base-dataset audio

fine_tune_chain.additions: Drum, vocal, mastering and level augmentation; synthetic low-register tones including pure sine waves and tones with harmonics, with sustained, decaying, slowly rising or brief notes (MIDI 21-60); Slakh2100-redux drum stems as unpitched negatives; per-pitch onset head trained jointly with the pitch heads; GeneralUser GS 2.0.3 renders replacing 10% of audio segments

training_sources_scope: Base audio sampling percentages; augmentation audio may occur in the same segment.
